source_log.note: MidAmerican's 2024 Resource Evaluation Study, filed November 2024, lists a 233 MW simple-cycle combustion turbine in 2033 in its preferred portfolio table. That matches GEM's start year of 2033. The study does not name a site, so this is an unsited placeholder. The plan is already cited for this unit, so there is nothing new to add.
